_comment: STILL image generation (studio headshots and portraits).
Hand this whole file to the image model, or paste one of the
strings under 'prompts'. GENERATE THIS FIRST: the chosen render
is the reference image that video.json requires.
Built from PERSONALITY + GENDER only - NOTHING here is derived from the
tutor's display name, because names are placeholders that will be
replaced. When renaming this tutor, pick a name that fits THIS file, not
the reverse. Gender and register are copied from tutor.md's documented

identity._heritage_note: a deliberate casting choice for a representative South African line-up; not inferred from any name
identity.build: rangy and fit, sun-toughened, easy athletic stance

face: long weathered face, deep squint lines at the corners of clear blue-grey eyes, tanned and freckled skin across the nose and forehead, stubble bleached at the tips, wind-chapped lips
hair: sandy-brown hair, sun-lightened, short and unruly under a hat, flattened where the brim sits

wardrobe.teaching: khaki or olive field shirt with rolled sleeves and buttoned chest pockets, zip-off trousers, worn hiking boots
alternates: fleece over the field shirt for early-morning shots
hat off, hair flattened, for headshots

accessories: battered field notebook with a pencil stub

presence.posture: one boot up on a rock, arm resting on the knee, pointing out to the horizon; crouches to pick up soil and crumble it
presence.default_expression: open enthusiasm, squinting into the light, grinning at the landscape as much as at the camera
presence.energy: trail-guide warmth - wants you to look at what he is looking at

_environment_reference: open highveld or escarpment at golden hour, layered hills, big sky, grass moving in the wind
_environment_note: NOT used for platform imagery - tutors are shot in studio. Owner, 2026-07-28: the student left the teachers in the classroom, so the platform does not show one. Kept only as character reference if a composite is ever wanted.
_continuity_note: the features that MUST survive every regeneration - if these read the same, the audience accepts it as the same person

prompts.headshot: Editorial headshot of a 35-42 year old White South African male teacher. long weathered face, deep squint lines at the corners of clear blue-grey eyes, tanned and freckled skin across the nose and forehead, stubble bleached at the tips, wind-chapped lips. Hair: sandy-brown hair, sun-lightened, short and unruly under a hat, flattened where the brim sits. Wearing khaki or olive field shirt with rolled sleeves and buttoned chest pockets, zip-off trousers, worn hiking boots. wide-brim bush hat. Hands relaxed and empty, holding nothing. Expression: open enthusiasm, squinting into the light, grinning at the landscape as much as at the camera. Chest-up, slight three-quarter turn, eyes to camera. large softbox key at 45 degrees, subtle hair light, seamless warm neutral grey studio backdrop. full-frame mirrorless, 85mm f/1.8. photorealistic editorial portrait photography, natural skin texture with visible pores and fine lines, subtle asymmetry, no beauty retouching, no plastic smoothing, true-to-life skin undertones, eyes alive and focused ON the lens rather than through it, moist eye surface with a bright asymmetric catchlight from the key light and a weaker one from the fill, visible iris striations and limbal ring, individual lower lashes, faint pink at the inner corner and a visible tear line, slight crinkle of the muscle at the outer corners, shallow depth of field.
prompts.studio: Studio portrait of a 35-42 year old White South African male teacher, waist-up. rangy and fit, sun-toughened, easy athletic stance. long weathered face, deep squint lines at the corners of clear blue-grey eyes, tanned and freckled skin across the nose and forehead, stubble bleached at the tips, wind-chapped lips. Hair: sandy-brown hair, sun-lightened, short and unruly under a hat, flattened where the brim sits. Wearing khaki or olive field shirt with rolled sleeves and buttoned chest pockets, zip-off trousers, worn hiking boots. wide-brim bush hat. Posture: stands relaxed and outdoorsy, shoulders open, thumbs hooked in his pockets. Hands relaxed and empty, holding nothing. Expression: open enthusiasm, squinting into the light, grinning at the landscape as much as at the camera. Plain empty seamless warm neutral grey studio backdrop, evenly lit, bare from edge to edge. two-light studio set: large softbox key at 45 degrees, soft fill opposite, gentle rim light to lift the shoulders off the backdrop. full-frame, 50mm f/2, waist-up. photorealistic editorial portrait photography, natural skin texture with visible pores and fine lines, subtle asymmetry, no beauty retouching, no plastic smoothing, true-to-life skin undertones, eyes alive and focused ON the lens rather than through it, moist eye surface with a bright asymmetric catchlight from the key light and a weaker one from the fill, visible iris striations and limbal ring, individual lower lashes, faint pink at the inner corner and a visible tear line, slight crinkle of the muscle at the outer corners, shallow depth of field.

negative_prompt: cartoon, illustration, 3d render, cgi, airbrushed skin, waxy skin, plastic sheen, over-saturated colours, HDR halos, extra fingers, malformed hands, distorted ears, text, watermark, logo, subtitles, teeth artefacts, dead eyes, glassy doll eyes, vacant thousand-yard stare, identical catchlights in both eyes, flat matte irises, eyes looking through the camera, mismatched gaze direction, classroom, school desks, chalkboard, whiteboard, notice boards, posters, any writing or notation in frame, invented mathematical notation, holding two pieces of chalk, duplicated props, set dressing, generic stock-photo smile
_negative_note: the cinematic terms are deliberate - image models drift toward a film-still look (grade, motion blur, flare) and then the render stops reading as a photograph

headshot.lighting: large softbox key at 45 degrees, subtle hair light, seamless warm neutral grey studio backdrop
headshot.framing: chest-up, eyes on the upper third, slight three-quarter turn

studio.lighting: two-light studio set: large softbox key at 45 degrees, soft fill opposite, gentle rim light to lift the shoulders off the backdrop
studio.framing: waist-up, centred or slightly off-centre with clean space beside the head for overlaid text
studio.backdrop: seamless warm neutral grey paper, evenly lit, no props, no furniture, no set dressing

_hands_rule: No held objects in any portrait prompt. The original generator inserted accessory #2 into a 'Holding one simple item' sentence regardless of whether it could be held, which is how a beaded wristband, a bangle, a watch and a pencil behind the ear all ended up 'held'. Objects belong in environment shots, on a surface.
